<!doctype html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-database-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
<title>Deposito San Donato · Monitoraggio Piazzale Ricarica | DepoTrack</title>
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#0b2a4a;--navy2:#123a63;--blue:#1d6fd1;--blue-l:#e8f1fc;--bg:#eef2f7;--card:#fff;--line:#dfe5ec;
  --txt:#1b2a3a;--sub:#6b7c8f;--red:#e0343d;--red-l:#fde8e9;--amber:#f4b400;--amber-l:#fff6d6;--green:#1f9d55;--green-l:#e7f6ee;
  --purple:#7a3fc0;--purple-l:#f1e9fb;
  /* colori shelter (come mappa XLSX) */
  --S1:#d9363e;--S1l:#fde4e5;--S2:#1f9d55;--S2l:#e6f6ec;--S3:#d4a900;--S3l:#fff5c7;--S4:#1f6fc5;--S4l:#e4effb;--S10:#2b2f33;--S10l:#ffffff;--OC:#6f8aa3;--OCl:#f2f5f8;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);font:13px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
svg.i{width:18px;height:18px;flex:0 0 18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

/* ---------- HEADER ---------- */
.top{height:60px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:0 18px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:118px;height:36px}
.logo .wm{font-weight:900;font-style:italic;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);padding:2px 14px;border-radius:6px}
.logo img{max-height:36px;max-width:150px;display:block}.logo.chip{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 10px;height:42px}.logo.chip img{max-height:30px}#logoMap img{max-height:44px;max-width:170px}
.vsep{width:1px;height:34px;background:#ffffff40}
.ttl b{display:block;font-size:19px;line-height:1.1}
.ttl span{font-size:13px;color:#cfe0f2}
.top .sp{flex:1}
.online{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:600}
.online i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#33d17a;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #33d17a33}
.online.warn i{background:#f4b400;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #f4b40033}
.online.bad i{background:#ff4d55;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #ff4d5533}
.upd{font-size:13px;color:#dbe7f5}.upd u{text-underline-offset:3px}
.hbtn{position:relative;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;border:0;background:#ffffff14;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.hbtn:hover{background:#ffffff26}
.hbtn .bdg{position:absolute;top:2px;right:2px;min-width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--red);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 4px}
.spin svg{animation:spin .6s linear}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* ---------- LAYOUT ---------- */
.shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;min-height:calc(100vh - 60px);background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--navy) 150px,transparent 150px)}
.side{background:var(--navy);padding:14px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;position:sticky;top:60px;height:calc(100vh - 60px)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:none;color:#d7e4f2;font-weight:600;text-align:left}
.nav:hover{background:#ffffff12}
.nav.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.main{padding:14px;min-width:0}
.page{display:none}.page.on{display:block}
.ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ph .ic{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center}
.ph .ic svg{width:24px;height:24px}
.ph h1{font-size:20px;margin:0}.ph p{margin:0;color:var(--sub)}
.ph .sp{flex:1}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:0 10px;height:38px;width:320px;max-width:100%}
.search input{border:0;outline:0;flex:1;min-width:0;background:none}
.btn{height:38px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:600}
.btn:hover{border-color:#b9c7d6;background:#f7fafd}
.btn.pri{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.btn.red{color:#b4232b;border-color:#f0c5c8;background:#fff7f7}
.btn.sm{height:30px;font-size:12px;padding:0 9px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 456px;gap:14px;align-items:start}.lcol .ph{margin-bottom:10px}.grid2>*{min-width:0}

/* ---------- FILTRI popover ---------- */
.fwrap{position:relative}
.pop{position:absolute;right:0;top:44px;width:270px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0b2a4a26;padding:12px;z-index:40;display:none}
.pop.on{display:block}
.pop h4{margin:4px 0 6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.pop label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:3px 0}
.pop select{width:100%;height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:0 8px}
.pop .row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ---------- MAPPA ---------- */
.map{padding:12px 14px 10px}
.mhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.mhead .logo .wm{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:22px}
.mtitle{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:1}
.mtitle h2{margin:0;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}.mtitle h2 small{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--sub);margin-left:6px}
.mtitle .l{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.mtitle .l u{text-underline-offset:3px}
.boxes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:8px 0 4px}
.sbox{border:1px solid #cfd8e2;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 10px 6px;background:#fff;min-height:0}
.sbox .hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800}.sbox .hd .i3d{width:22px!important;height:22px!important}
.sbox .hd .n{margin-left:auto;min-width:36px;text-align:center;border-radius:4px;padding:0 7px;font-size:16px}
.sbox .hd .p{font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;min-width:46px;text-align:right}
.sbox.r .n{background:var(--red);color:#fff}.sbox.y .n{background:var(--amber);color:#2a2000}.sbox.s .n{background:none;font-size:20px}
.sbox table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:6px;font-size:11px}
.sbox th{font-weight:600;color:var(--sub);text-align:left;padding:1px 4px}
.sbox td{padding:1px 4px;white-space:nowrap}
.sbox .empty{color:var(--sub);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:3px}.sbox .chips{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px}.sbox .chips span{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;background:#f1f4f8;border-radius:5px;padding:1px 6px}.sbox .chips span b{margin-right:3px}.sbox.r .chips span{background:#fdecee}.sbox.y .chips span{background:#fff6d6}.sbox.s .chips span{background:var(--purple-l)}

.yscroll{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}
.yard{position:relative;width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
.rows{width:1070px;padding-left:40px;position:relative}.rows::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:30px;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(#eaf2fb,#eaf2fb00 96%)}
.lane{height:32px;position:relative}
.lane .ar{position:absolute;top:9px;color:#1d5f99;line-height:0}
.lane .ar svg{width:28px;height:14px}
.lane .ar.dn{top:-2px}.lane .ar.dn svg{width:18px;height:36px}
.yrow{height:60px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;padding-right:26px}
.yrow .lt{position:absolute;right:4px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.grp{display:flex;gap:2px}
.t{width:47px;height:60px;border:1.6px solid var(--c);background:var(--cl);border-radius:3px;padding:2px 0 1px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;line-height:1;position:relative;transition:transform .08s,box-shadow .1s}
.t .kw{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.t b{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.045em;white-space:nowrap}
.t .sl{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#4c5a68}
.t:hover{outline:2px dashed var(--blue);outline-offset:2px;z-index:3}
.t.sel{outline:3px solid var(--blue)!important;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #1d6fd126;z-index:4}
.t.ko{background:var(--red);border-color:#a8161f;color:#fff}.t.ko .sl{color:#ffe1e3}
.t.deg{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd23f 0 6px,#ffe27a 6px 12px);border-color:#c79200;color:#3d2c00}.t.deg .sl{color:#5d4600}
.t.sin{background:var(--purple);border-color:#4f2286;color:#fff}.t.sin .sl{color:#eadcff}
.t .flag{position:absolute;top:-7px;right:-6px;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 3px;background:#fff;border:1px solid currentColor;display:none}
.t.ko .flag,.t.sin .flag{display:block;color:#b4232b}.t.sin .flag{color:var(--purple)}
.t.dim{opacity:.18}
.t.hit{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ff9f1a}
.s-S1{--c:var(--S1);--cl:var(--S1l)}.s-S2{--c:var(--S2);--cl:var(--S2l)}.s-S3{--c:var(--S3);--cl:var(--S3l)}.s-S4{--c:var(--S4);--cl:var(--S4l)}.s-S10{--c:var(--S10);--cl:var(--S10l)}.s-OC{--c:var(--OC);--cl:var(--OCl)}
.shbox{border:0;border-radius:3px;color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;text-align:center;padding:4px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.shbox:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.shbox.ko{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px}
.sh-S1{background:#c8262e}.sh-S2{background:#1c8a4b}.sh-S3{background:#f5d000;color:#1b1b1b;border:1.5px solid #1b1b1b}.sh-S4{background:#1f6fc5}.sh-S10{background:#111}.sh-OC{background:#b9d4ee;color:#0b2a4a;border:1.5px solid #6f8aa3}
.rcol{position:absolute;left:1076px;top:0;width:104px}
.rcol .t{position:absolute;left:24px;width:60px}
.rcol .mlt{position:absolute;left:0;font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.rcol .shbox{position:absolute;left:16px;width:88px;min-height:48px;font-size:11px}
.rcol .ar{position:absolute;left:46px;color:#1d5f99}.rcol .ar svg{width:20px;height:36px}
.yfoot{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-top:2px;padding-left:40px}
.yfoot .stack{display:flex;flex-direction:row;gap:8px}
.yfoot .stack .shbox{min-height:40px;width:118px;font-size:11px}
.yfoot{pointer-events:none;z-index:1}.yfoot .shbox{pointer-events:auto}
.yfoot .notes{font-size:11.5px;color:#3b4a59;line-height:1.35}
.legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:4px;padding-top:9px;font-size:12px}
.legend b{font-size:12px}
.lg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.lg i{width:20px;height:18px;border-radius:3px;border:2px solid}
.lg small{display:block;color:var(--sub);font-size:10px;line-height:1}
.hintbox{margin-left:auto;background:var(--blue-l);color:#174a85;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:500}

/* ---------- COLONNA DESTRA ---------- */
.rside{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:sticky;top:66px;max-height:calc(100vh - 72px);overflow:auto;margin-top:-8px;padding-bottom:4px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.rside .card{padding:7px 12px;flex:0 0 auto}.rside .ch{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px}
.ch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.ch svg{color:var(--blue)}.ch .sp{flex:1}.ch a{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px}
.kpi{border-radius:8px;padding:5px 7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#f3f7fc;min-width:0}.kpi>div:last-child{min-width:0}
.kpi .ki{width:28px;height:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 28px}
.kpi .ki .i3d{width:30px;height:30px}.kpi .ki{background:none!important;width:32px;height:32px;flex:0 0 32px}
.kpi small{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.kpi b{display:block;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.kpi.b .ki{color:var(--blue)}.kpi.b b{color:#0f3a66}
.kpi.r{background:var(--red-l)}.kpi.r .ki{background:var(--red);color:#fff}.kpi.r b{color:#c4232c}
.kpi.g{background:var(--green-l)}.kpi.g .ki{color:var(--green)}.kpi.g b{color:#167a40}
.levels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.lv{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:4px 4px;line-height:1.25;text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#3d4c5b;background:#fff}
.lv .dot{font-size:14px;line-height:1.1;display:block}
.lv.on.n0{background:var(--green-l);border-color:var(--green)}
.lv.on.n1{background:#fff8e1;border-color:#e3b23c}
.lv.on.n2{background:#fff0dc;border:2px solid #f08a1c}
.lv.on.n3{background:#ffe5e7;border:2px solid var(--red)}
.lv .lsub{display:block;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;margin-top:1px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;letter-spacing:-.01em}.lv .lsub:empty{display:none}.lv.on.n2 .lsub{color:#9a4d00}.lv.on.n3 .lsub{color:#a3141d}.lv.on.n1 .lsub{color:#7a5a00}
.amsg{margin-top:5px;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px;line-height:1.35;font-size:12.5px}
.amsg.n0{background:var(--green-l);color:#14683a}.amsg.n1{background:#fff8e1;color:#7a5a00}.amsg.n2{background:#fff0dc;color:#9a4d00}.amsg.n3{background:#ffe5e7;color:#a3141d}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:12px}
.two.b{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.donut{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0}.donut svg{width:92px;height:92px}
.bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;height:72px;padding:0 4px 0 22px;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid #c9d3dd}
.bars .ax{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--sub)}
.bar{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;height:100%}
.bar i{display:block;width:100%;max-width:34px;border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;background:var(--red)}
.bar i.y{background:var(--amber)}
.bar span{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
.blab{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:3px 4px 0 22px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.blab span{flex:1;text-align:center}
table.tt{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
table.tt th{text-align:left;background:#eef3f8;padding:4px 8px;font-weight:700}
table.tt th:last-child,table.tt td:last-child{text-align:right}
table.tt td{padding:2px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f4}
table.tt tr.tot td{font-weight:800;background:#eef3f8}
.cmf{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.cmf .it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#f6f8fb;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 9px}
.cmf .it svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.cmf .it>div{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.cmf .it small{font-size:11.5px;color:#3d4c5b}
.cmf .it b{font-size:16px}
.cmf .it.g{background:var(--green-l)}
table.ev{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
table.ev th{text-align:left;background:#eef3f8;padding:5px 6px;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px}#lastEv td:last-child{white-space:normal;max-width:120px}#fullEv td:last-child{white-space:normal}
table.ev td{white-space:nowrap;font-size:11.5px;padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f4;vertical-align:middle}
.pill{display:inline-block;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid}
.pill.ko{background:#ffe3e5;color:#b4232b;border-color:#f3a7ac}
.pill.deg{background:#fff4c7;color:#7a5a00;border-color:#efd26c}
.pill.sin{background:var(--purple-l);color:var(--purple);border-color:#cfb3f0}
.pill.sel{background:#e3efff;color:#1d5fc0;border-color:#8fb8ef}.pill.ok{background:var(--green-l);color:#14683a;border-color:#9fd8b6}
.muted{color:var(--sub)}

/* ---------- MODALE ---------- */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0b2a4a66;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:14px}
.ov.on{display:flex}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;width:420px;max-width:100%;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 60px #0b2a4a55}
.modal .mh{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.modal .mh .t{pointer-events:none}
.modal .mh h3{margin:0;font-size:17px}.modal .mh p{margin:0;color:var(--sub);font-size:12px}
.modal .mb{padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 12px;font-size:12px}
.kv span{color:var(--sub)}.kv b{text-align:right}
.stbtn{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}
.stbtn button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 2px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.stbtn button.on[data-m=ok]{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-l);color:#14683a}
.stbtn button.on[data-m=ko]{border-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-l);color:#b4232b}
.stbtn button.on[data-m=deg]{border-color:#e3b23c;background:var(--amber-l);color:#7a5a00}
.stbtn button.on[data-m=sin]{border-color:var(--purple);background:var(--purple-l);color:var(--purple)}
.fld label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.fld input[type=text],.fld select,.fld input[type=number]{width:100%;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:0 9px}
.fld input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#e3a500}
.modal .mf{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px}

/* ---------- ALTRE PAGINE ---------- */
.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.pgrid .card{padding:14px}
.pgrid .w2{grid-column:span 2}.pgrid .w3{grid-column:1/-1}
.big{font-size:28px;font-weight:800}
.note{background:#f1f6fc;border-left:4px solid var(--blue);border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#2a4a6b}
.note.w{background:#fff8e8;border-color:#e3a53c;color:#7a5410}
.hrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr 34px;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;margin:5px 0}
.hrow .tr{background:#eef2f6;height:10px;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}.hrow .tr i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--blue)}
.setrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f4}
.setrow input,.setrow select{width:100px;height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:0 8px}
.flexw{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tabb{height:34px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:17px;font-weight:700}.tabb.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}tr.hot td{background:#fff1f2}tr.hotd td{background:#fff9e3}.win.s{color:#c4232c;font-weight:800}.win.m{color:#b88a00;font-weight:700}
.shgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.shc{border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-left:6px solid var(--c);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 9px;text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.shc:hover{background:#f6f9fc;border-color:#b9c7d6;border-left-color:var(--c)}
.shc b{font-size:13px}.shc small{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.shc .st{align-self:flex-start;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:9px;padding:1px 7px;background:var(--green-l);color:#14683a}
.shc .st.p{background:#fff4c7;color:#7a5a00}.shc .st.k{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.shc.k{background:#fff1f2;border-color:#f3a7ac;border-left-color:var(--red)}
.shbox.ko{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#0000 0 7px,#e0343d88 7px 12px)}
.shbox .kob{display:block;margin-top:2px;background:#fff;color:var(--red);border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;padding:0 3px}
.t.shko{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#e0343d 0 6px,#c4232c 6px 12px)}
.warnbox{background:#fff1f2;border:1px solid #f3a7ac;color:#9d1a22;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px}
.bigbtn{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.bigbtn button{padding:12px 6px;border-radius:9px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:800}
.bigbtn button.on[data-k="1"]{background:var(--red);border-color:#a8161f;color:#fff}
.bigbtn button.on[data-k="0"]{background:var(--green-l);border-color:var(--green);color:#14683a}
@media (max-width:820px){html.mob .shgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
html.zoomed .rside{position:static;max-height:none;overflow:visible}html.zoomed .side{position:static;height:auto}
.i3d{display:inline-block;flex:0 0 auto;background:center/contain no-repeat;vertical-align:middle}.i3d.dash{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.piazzale{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.segn{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.usc{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.anal{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.report{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.set{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.kiosk{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.refresh{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.bell{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.user{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.view{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.search{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.filter{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.info{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.lv0{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.lv1{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.lv2{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.lv3{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.antenna{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.cmf{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.clock{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.totali{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.ko{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.pct{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.kwpersi{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.residua{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.installata{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.degrado{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.i3d.sinistro{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}
.nav .chip3d{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;background:#f3f7fc;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 32px;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #0b2a4a22;transition:transform .15s}.nav .chip3d .i3d{width:24px;height:24px}.nav:hover .chip3d{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1.04)}.nav.on .chip3d{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0b2a4a55}
.ph .ic.ic3d{background:none;width:46px;height:46px}.ph .ic.ic3d .i3d{width:44px;height:44px}
.hbtn .i3d{width:26px;height:26px}
/* ===== FIREBASE ===== */
.dbst{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:12px;background:#ffffff14;color:#cfe0f2;white-space:nowrap}
.dbst::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#8aa0b6}
.dbst.live::before{background:#33d17a;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #33d17a33}.dbst.err::before{background:#ff4d55}.dbst.wait::before{background:#f4b400}
#btnUser{position:relative}#btnUser .lk{position:absolute;right:-3px;bottom:-3px;font-size:11px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-radius:7px;padding:0 3px;line-height:15px;font-weight:900}
#btnUser.un .lk{background:#33d17a;color:#fff}
#ovLogin{z-index:120}
.ro-note{display:none;background:#fff4d6;color:#7a5410;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}
html.cloud:not(.unlocked) .ro-note{display:block}
/* ===== SCATTO PDF ===== */
html.snap *,html.snap *::before,html.snap *::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
html.snap .rside{position:static!important;max-height:none!important;overflow:visible!important}
html.snap .side{position:static!important;height:auto!important}
html.snap .top{position:static!important}
html.snap .t:hover{outline:none}
.pdfwait{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:#0b2a4acc;color:#fff;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;gap:12px}
.pdfwait.on{display:flex}.pdfwait i{width:22px;height:22px;border:3px solid #ffffff55;border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite!important}
/* ===== MAPPA GRANDE ===== */
html.bigmap .grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
html.bigmap .rside{position:static;max-height:none;overflow:visible;margin-top:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr 1.25fr;gap:10px;align-items:start}
html.bigmap .rside>.card:last-child{grid-column:span 1}
html.bigmap #btnBig{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
/* ===== MODALITÀ MONITOR ===== */
#kbar{display:none}
html.kiosk .side,html.kiosk #btnView,html.kiosk #btnKiosk,html.kiosk #btnUser,html.kiosk #btnRefresh,html.kiosk .lcol .ph .search,html.kiosk .lcol .ph .fwrap,html.kiosk .ph .btn,html.kiosk .ph label.btn,html.kiosk .ph .search{display:none!important}
html.kiosk .shell{grid-template-columns:1fr;background:none}
html.kiosk .rside{position:static;max-height:none;overflow:visible}
html.kiosk body{overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:54px}
html.kiosk #kbar{display:block;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:150;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:15px}
.kprog{height:4px;background:#ffffff1f}.kprog i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff7a1a,#e0343d)}
.krow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:8px 18px}
.krow .sp{flex:1}.kdot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#33d17a;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #33d17a33}
.kleft{color:#b9cde3;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.kclock{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.02em}
.ksteps{display:flex;gap:6px}.ksteps i{width:26px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:#ffffff33}.ksteps i.on{background:#fff}
.krow button{background:#ffffff14;border:1px solid #ffffff2a;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;height:34px;padding:0 12px;font-weight:700}
.krow button:hover{background:#ffffff26}
html.kiosk.paused .kdot{background:#f4b400;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #f4b40033}
html.kiosk .page.on{animation:kIn .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes kIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
/* ===== MOVIMENTO ===== */
@keyframes tileOn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #1d6fd100}55%{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #1d6fd133}100%{opacity:1;transform:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #1d6fd100}}
.yard.boot .t{animation:tileOn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both;animation-delay:var(--d,0ms)}
@keyframes koRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #e0343d88}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #e0343d00}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #e0343d00}}
@keyframes sinRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #7a3fc088}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #7a3fc000}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #7a3fc000}}
.t.ko:not(.shko){animation:koRing 2.4s ease-out infinite}.t.sin{animation:sinRing 2.4s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes flipOff{0%{transform:scale(1)}35%{transform:scale(.82) rotateX(70deg);filter:brightness(1.6)}100%{transform:none}}
@keyframes flipOn{0%{transform:scale(1)}35%{transform:scale(1.14);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #33d17a55}100%{transform:none}}
.t.chg-off{animation:flipOff .5s cubic-bezier(.3,.6,.2,1) both!important;animation-delay:var(--w,0ms)!important}
.t.chg-on{animation:flipOn .5s cubic-bezier(.3,.6,.2,1) both!important;animation-delay:var(--w,0ms)!important}
.yard{perspective:900px}
@keyframes shPulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #e0343dcc}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px #e0343d00}}
.shbox.blast{animation:shPulse .8s ease-out 2}
.online i{position:relative}.online i::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid currentColor;color:#33d17a;animation:live 2s ease-out infinite}
.online.warn i::after{color:#f4b400}.online.bad i::after{color:#ff4d55;animation-duration:1.1s}
@keyframes live{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(2);opacity:0}}
.lv{transition:background .35s,border-color .35s,transform .35s}.lv.on{transform:translateY(-2px)}
@keyframes emer{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #e0343d00}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #e0343d2e}}
.lv.on.n3{animation:emer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.amsg{transition:background .35s,color .35s}
#donutArc{transition:stroke-dasharray .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.bar i{transition:height .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),background .3s}
.kpi b,.sbox .n{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi b.bump{animation:bump .5s ease-out}@keyframes bump{0%{transform:scale(1)}40%{transform:scale(1.08)}100%{transform:none}}
.kpi{transition:transform .15s}
@keyframes ovIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}@keyframes modIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.ov.on{animation:ovIn .18s ease-out;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}.ov.on .modal{animation:modIn .26s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.page.on{animation:ovIn .25s ease-out}
.t:focus-visible,.shbox:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.nav:focus-visible,.hbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffb020;outline-offset:2px}
#toast{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}#toast::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#33d17a;flex:0 0 8px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
#toast{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);transition:.2s;pointer-events:none;z-index:200;max-width:340px}
#toast.on{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- RESPONSIVE ---------- */
@media (max-width:1500px){html.mob .grid2{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 400px}
html.mob .kpi b{font-size:15px}}
@media (max-width:1250px){html.mob .grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
html.mob .rside{position:static;max-height:none;overflow:visible;margin-top:0}
html.mob .boxes{margin:12px 0 6px;gap:12px}}
@media (max-width:820px){html.mob .top{height:auto;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 12px;gap:10px}
html.mob .upd,html.mob .vsep{display:none}
html.mob .ttl b{font-size:16px}
html.mob .ttl span{font-size:11px}
html.mob .shell{grid-template-columns:1fr;background:none}
html.mob .side{position:sticky;top:0;height:auto;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;padding:6px;z-index:45}
html.mob .nav{white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 10px}
html.mob .main{padding:10px}
html.mob .mhead{grid-template-columns:1fr}
html.mob .mhead>.logo,html.mob .mhead>.ghost{display:none}
html.mob .boxes{grid-template-columns:1fr}
html.mob .kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
html.mob .two,html.mob .two.b{grid-template-columns:1fr}
html.mob .pgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
html.mob .pgrid .w2{grid-column:auto}
html.mob .search{width:100%}
html.mob .hintbox{margin-left:0}}
@media print{.top,.side,.ph .sp~*,#toast{display:none!important}.shell{display:block}.page{display:none!important}#pg-report{display:block!important}.card{border-color:#ccc}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ================= HEADER ================= -->
<header class="top">
  <div class="logo chip" id="logoTop"></div>
  <div class="vsep"></div>
  <div class="ttl"><b>Deposito San Donato</b><span>Monitoraggio Piazzale di Ricarica Bus Elettrici</span></div>
  <div class="sp"></div>
  <div class="online" id="online"><i></i><span>Impianto online</span></div>
  <div class="vsep"></div>
  <span class="dbst" id="dbst" title="Collegamento al database">Locale</span>
  <div class="upd">Ultimo aggiornamento: <u id="updTxt">—</u></div>
  <button class="hbtn" id="btnKiosk" title="Modalità monitor: apre la vista per lo schermo grande"><i class="i3d kiosk"></i></button>
  <button class="hbtn" id="btnView" title="Cambia vista: completa / telefono"><i class="i3d view"></i></button>
  <button class="hbtn" id="btnRefresh" title="Aggiorna"><i class="i3d refresh"></i></button>
  <button class="hbtn" id="btnBell" title="Anomalie attive"><i class="i3d bell"></i><span class="bdg" id="bellN">0</span></button>
  <button class="hbtn" id="btnUser" title="Operatore"><i class="i3d user"></i></button>
</header>

<div class="shell">
<!-- ================= SIDEBAR ================= -->
<nav class="side">
  <button class="nav" data-p="dash"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d dash"></i></span>Dashboard</button>
  <button class="nav on" data-p="piazzale"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d piazzale"></i></span>Piazzale</button>
  <button class="nav" data-p="segn"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d segn"></i></span>Segnalazioni</button>
  <button class="nav" data-p="usc"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d usc"></i></span>Uscite</button>
  <button class="nav" data-p="anal"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d anal"></i></span>Analisi</button>
  <button class="nav" data-p="report"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d report"></i></span>Report</button>
  <button class="nav" data-p="set"><span class="chip3d"><i class="i3d set"></i></span>Impostazioni</button>
</nav>

<main class="main">
<!-- ================= PIAZZALE ================= -->
<section class="page on" id="pg-piazzale">
  <div class="grid2">
   <div class="lcol">
  <div class="ph">
    <div class="ic ic3d"><i class="i3d piazzale"></i></div>
    <div><h1>Piazzale – Mappa Colonnine</h1><p>Stato, potenza e disponibilità dei punti di ricarica del Deposito San Donato</p></div>
    <div class="sp"></div>
    <label class="search"><i class="i3d search" style="width:20px;height:20px"></i><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Cerca colonnina (es. A1, C10, 4.3-11...)"></label>
    <div class="fwrap">
      <button class="btn" id="btnFilt"><i class="i3d filter" style="width:20px;height:20px"></i>Filtri <span id="filtN"></span> ▾</button>
      <div class="pop" id="pop">
        <h4>Shelter</h4>
        <select id="fG"><option value="all">Tutti</option><option value="S1">Shelter 1 · Alstom</option><option value="S2">Shelter 2 · ABB</option><option value="S3">Shelter 3 · COET</option><option value="S4">Shelter 4 · Siemens</option><option value="S10">Shelter 10 · Solaris</option><option value="OC">Cabina O.C. · Alstom</option></select>
        <h4 style="margin-top:12px">Stato</h4>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="fS" value="ok" checked> Disponibile</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="fS" value="ko" checked> Guasta</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="fS" value="deg" checked> Degrado</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="fS" value="sin" checked> Sinistro</label>
        <div class="row"><button class="btn sm" id="fReset">Mostra tutto</button><button class="btn sm" id="fDemo">Scenario demo</button><button class="btn sm red" id="fZero">Azzera guasti</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>


    <!-- MAPPA -->
    <article class="card map">
      <div class="mhead">
        <div class="logo" id="logoMap"></div>
        <div class="mtitle">
          <h2>DEPOSITO SAN DONATO<small>Rev. 3</small></h2>
          <div class="l">SITUAZIONE PIAZZALE &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Al <span id="mapDate">—</span></div>
          <div class="l"><u>Potenza installata&nbsp; <span id="mapKw">10.380 kW</span></u></div>
          <div class="l"><u>Punti di ricarica totali&nbsp; <span id="mapN">114</span></u></div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnPdf" title="Crea un PDF A3 della pagina così come la vedi">⬇ PDF A3</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnBig" title="Sposta la dashboard sotto la mappa per ingrandire il piazzale">⤢ Mappa grande</button>
      </div>

      <div class="boxes">
        <div class="sbox r" id="boxKo"></div>
        <div class="sbox y" id="boxDeg"></div>
        <div class="sbox s" id="boxSin"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="yscroll" id="yscroll"><div class="yard" id="yard"></div></div>

      <div class="legend">
        <b>Legenda stato colonnine:</b>
        <span class="lg"><i style="border-color:var(--green);background:#fff"></i><span>OK<small>(disponibile)</small></span></span>
        <span class="lg"><i style="border-color:#c79200;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd23f 0 4px,#ffe27a 4px 8px)"></i><span>Degrado<small>(potenza ridotta)</small></span></span>
        <span class="lg"><i style="border-color:#a8161f;background:var(--red)"></i><span>Guasta<small>(indisponibile)</small></span></span>
        <span class="lg"><i style="border-color:#4f2286;background:var(--purple)"></i><span>Sinistro<small>(indisponibile)</small></span></span>
        <span class="lg"><i style="border-color:var(--blue);border-width:3px"></i><span>Selezionata</span></span>
        <span class="lg"><i style="border:2px dashed var(--blue)"></i><span>Hover<small>(anteprima selezione)</small></span></span>
        <span class="hintbox"><i class="i3d info" style="width:22px;height:22px"></i>Clicca su una colonnina per segnalarla come guasta</span>
      </div>
      
    </article>

   </div>
    <!-- COLONNA DESTRA -->
    <aside class="rside">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="ch"><i class="i3d anal" style="width:22px;height:22px"></i>Sintesi Impianto</div>
        <div class="kpis">
          <div class="kpi b"><div class="ki"><i class="i3d totali"></i></div><div><small>Punti totali</small><b id="kTot">114</b></div></div>
          <div class="kpi r"><div class="ki"><i class="i3d ko"></i></div><div><small>Punti KO</small><b id="kKo">0</b></div></div>
          <div class="kpi r"><div class="ki"><i class="i3d pct"></i></div><div><small>% KO</small><b id="kPct">0 %</b></div></div>
          <div class="kpi r" style="background:#fff3f3"><div class="ki"><i class="i3d kwpersi"></i></div><div><small>kW persi</small><b id="kLost">0 kW</b></div></div>
          <div class="kpi g"><div class="ki"><i class="i3d residua"></i></div><div><small>Potenza residua</small><b id="kRes">10.380 kW</b></div></div>
          <div class="kpi b"><div class="ki"><i class="i3d installata"></i></div><div><small>Pot. installata</small><b id="kInst">10.380 kW</b></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>


      <div class="card">
        <div class="ch"><i class="i3d antenna" style="width:22px;height:22px"></i>Stato allerta impianto<span class="sp"></span><a data-go="set" title="Soglie di allerta"><i class="i3d info" style="width:20px;height:20px"></i></a></div>
        <div class="levels">
          <div class="lv n0" data-l="0" data-base="Nessun impatto"><span class="dot"><i class="i3d lv0" style="width:22px;height:22px"></i></span>Nessun impatto</div>

Non si conoscono SOC, ricariche in corso, seconde movimentazioni né la disponibilità reale delle colonnine alternative.       <tr><td>Due shelter fra 1, 2, 4, 10 fuori servizio</td><td>Emergenza grave</td></tr><tr><td>Tre o più shelter fuori servizio · black-out</td><td>Emergenza massima</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Shelter 3 COET fuori servizio</td><td>Criticità localizzata</td></tr><tr><td>Uno o due pantografi O.C. KO</td><td>Allerta funzionale</td></tr>

      <div class="setrow"><span><b>Emergenza massima</b> da % punti o potenza</span><input type="number" id="cEm" min="1" max="100" step="0.5"></div>

const toMin=x=>+x.slice(0,2)*60+ +x.slice(3);
const U=U_RAW.map((a,i)=>{const o=toMin(a[2]);let rr=toMin(a[7]);if(rr<o)rr+=1440;return{i,u:a[0],uq:UQ[a[0]],n:a[1],out:a[2],o,turno:a[3],line:a[4],rin:a[7],r:rr,el:!!a[9]}});
const posto=d=>/^[A-Z]\d\d$/.test(d)?d[0]+(+d.slice(1)):d;
const G={S1:{n:'Shelter 1',lab:'SHELTER 1',brand:'ALSTOM'},S2:{n:'Shelter 2',lab:'SHELTER 2',brand:'ABB'},S3:{n:'Shelter 3',lab:'SHELTER 3',brand:'COET'},S4:{n:'Shelter 4',lab:'SHELTER 4',brand:'SIEMENS'},S10:{n:'Shelter 10',lab:'SHELTER 10',brand:'SOLARIS'},OC:{n:'Cabina O.C.',lab:'CABINA O.C.',brand:'ALSTOM'}};
const GK=['S1','S2','S3','S4','S10','OC'];
for(const g of GK){const ps=P.filter(p=>p.g===g);G[g].pts=ps.length;G[g].kw=ps.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.kw,0)}
const N=P.length,KW=P.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.kw,0),BY=Object.fromEntries(P.map(p=>[p.id,p]));
const BYSLOT=Object.fromEntries(P.map(p=>[p.slot,p]));
const R=U.filter(x=>x.el).map(x=>({t:x.r%1440,d:x.r>=1440?1:0,turno:x.turno,line:x.line,src:x.uq+' n.'+x.n,out:x.out})).sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);
/* stima: su una quota pari alla % di punti indisponibili, distribuita in modo uniforme nella giornata */
function quota(ev,frac){const out=[];let acc=.5;for(const e of ev){acc+=frac;if(acc>=1){out.push(e);acc-=1}}return out}

const ST_LAB={ok:'Disponibile',ko:'Guasta',deg:'Degrado',sin:'Sinistro'};
const KEY='depotrack_sandonato_piazzale_v3';
const DEF_CFG={kd:20,kp:30,al:3,aa:5,eo:15,eg:40,egc:25,em:60,wait:15,op:'Operatore 1',logo:'',lv2:1};

/* ======================= STATO ======================= */
let S={st:{},shKo:{},sel:null,hist:[],upd:null,cfg:{...DEF_CFG}};
let F={g:'all',st:new Set(['ok','ko','deg','sin']),q:''};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const fmt=(n,d=0)=>{const v=Number(n);if(!isFinite(v))return'—';const[i,dec]=Math.abs(v).toFixed(d).split('.');return(v<0?'-':'')+i.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,'.')+(d?','+dec:'')};
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const slotTxt=s=>s.replace(/^([A-Z])0/,'$1');
const hm=t=>{const m=((t%1440)+1440)%1440;return String(Math.floor(m/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m%60).padStart(2,'0')};
const dt=(iso,full)=>{const d=new Date(iso);return d.toLocaleDateString('it-IT',full?{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'}:{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit'})+' '+d.toLocaleTimeString('it-IT',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})};
function toast(m){const t=$('toast');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(toast.h);toast.h=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),2600)}
function load(){try{const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ONLINE?CKEY:KEY)||'null');if(v){S.st={};for(const[id,x]of Object.entries(v.st||{}))if(BY[id]&&['ko','deg','sin'].includes(x.m))S.st[id]=x;S.shKo={};for(const[g,x]of Object.entries(v.shKo||{}))if(G[g])S.shKo[g]=x;S.hist=Array.isArray(v.hist)?v.hist.slice(0,500):[];S.upd=v.upd||null;S.cfg=(v.cfg&&v.cfg.lv2)?{...DEF_CFG,...v.cfg}:{...DEF_CFG,op:v.cfg?.op||DEF_CFG.op,logo:v.cfg?.logo||'',wait:v.cfg?.wait??15};S.sel=v.sel&&BY[v.sel]?v.sel:null;S.selT=v.selT||null;return true}}catch(e){console.warn(e)}return false}
function save(touch=true){if(touch){S.upd=new Date().toISOString();cloudSet('upd',S.upd)}try{localStorage.setItem(ONLINE?CKEY:KEY,JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}}
/* cascata: se lo shelter è KO tutte le sue colonnine risultano KO; lo stato proprio resta salvato sotto */
const own=p=>S.st[p.id]?.m||'ok';
const viaSh=p=>!!S.shKo[p.g];
const mode=p=>viaSh(p)?'ko':own(p);
const lost=p=>{if(viaSh(p))return p.kw;const x=S.st[p.id];if(!x)return 0;if(x.m==='deg')return p.kw*(x.loss||50)/100;return p.kw};
const unav=p=>['ko','sin'].includes(mode(p));

function setPoint(id,m,{loss=50,op='',note=''}={},log=true){
  const p=BY[id];if(!p)return;
  if(m==='ok')delete S.st[id];else S.st[id]={m,loss:m==='deg'?loss:100,op,note,t:new Date().toISOString()};
  cloudPoint(id);
  if(log)pushHist({t:new Date().toISOString(),id,slot:p.slot,m,op,note});
}
function setShelter(g,ko,op,note){
  WAVE_FROM=g;
  setTimeout(()=>document.querySelectorAll(`.shbox[data-sh="${g}"]`).forEach(x=>{x.classList.remove('blast');void x.offsetWidth;x.classList.add('blast')}),30);
  const t=new Date().toISOString();
  if(ko)S.shKo[g]={op,note,t};else delete S.shKo[g];
  cloudSet('shKo/'+g,S.shKo[g]||null);
  const single=P.filter(p=>p.g===g&&own(p)!=='ok').length;
  pushHist({t,id:G[g].lab,slot:'—',m:ko?'ko':'ok',op,note:(ko?'SHELTER KO · '+G[g].pts+' punti fuori servizio':'Shelter ripristinato'+(single?' · restano '+single+' segnalazioni singole':''))+(note?' · '+note:'')});
  save();render();toast(G[g].n+(ko?' KO: '+G[g].pts+' colonnine fuori servizio':' ripristinato'));
}
let SHG=null,SHK=0;
function openShelter(g){SHG=g;SHK=S.shKo[g]?1:0;const x=S.shKo[g];
  const ps=P.filter(p=>p.g===g),single=ps.filter(p=>own(p)!=='ok').length;
  $('shHead').innerHTML=`<div class="shbox sh-${g}" style="width:84px;height:44px">${g==='OC'?'CABINA':G[g].lab}<br>${G[g].brand}</div><div><h3>${G[g].n}</h3><p>${G[g].brand} · ${fmt(G[g].kw)} kW installati</p></div>`;
  $('shKv').innerHTML=`<span>Colonnine collegate</span><b>${ps.length}</b><span>Stato attuale</span><b style="color:${x?'var(--red)':'#167a40'}">${x?'KO dal '+dt(x.t):'In servizio'}</b><span>Segnalazioni singole</span><b>${single}</b>`+(x?`<span>Segnalato da</span><b>${esc(x.op)||'--'}</b>`:'');
  $('shOp').value=x?.op||S.cfg.op;$('shNote').value=x?.note||'';setSHK(SHK);$('ovSh').classList.add('on')}
function setSHK(k){SHK=k;$('shBtns').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',+b.dataset.k===k));const ps=P.filter(p=>p.g===SHG);
  $('shInfo').innerHTML=k?`Tutte le <b>${ps.length}</b> colonnine di ${G[SHG].n} andranno KO (${fmt(G[SHG].kw)} kW persi). I guasti già segnati sulle singole colonnine restano memorizzati.`:`Le colonnine tornano allo stato che avevano prima del KO shelter.`}
function closeShelter(){$('ovSh').classList.remove('on');SHG=null}
function saveShelter(){if(!SHG)return;if(!canEdit())return;const g=SHG,was=!!S.shKo[g],op=$('shOp').value.trim(),note=$('shNote').value.trim();closeShelter();if(op)S.cfg.op=op;if(was===!!SHK&&!(SHK&&note!==(S.shKo[g]?.note||'')))return;setShelter(g,!!SHK,op,note)}
function demo(){S.st={};S.hist=[];const now=Date.now(),ago=m=>new Date(now-m*60000).toISOString();
  S.shKo={};const set=(id,m,op,note,min,loss=50)=>{const p=BY[id];S.st[id]={m,loss:m==='deg'?loss:100,op,note,t:ago(min)};S.hist.unshift({t:ago(min),id,slot:p.slot,m,op,note})};
  set('1.20','ko','Operatore 1','Errore ricarica',165);set('10.20','deg','Operatore 2','Potenza ridotta',150,40);set('3.5','deg','Operatore 2','Potenza ridotta',140,30);set('O.C.2','sin','Operatore 1','Pantografo urtato da vettura',120);
  set('3.4','deg','Operatore 2','Ventole in allarme',110,25);set('4.4-9','ko','Operatore 3','Non avvia la sessione',95);set('2.5A','deg','Operatore 1','Si scollega dopo 10 min',80,50);set('4.2-15','deg','Operatore 3','Potenza ridotta',70,35);
  set('10.12','ko','Operatore 2','Display spento',55);set('1.15','deg','Operatore 1','Connettore caldo',45,40);set('3.8','deg','Operatore 2','Potenza ridotta',33,50);set('1.2','ko','Operatore 1','Non comunica',25);
  S.sel='2.2A';S.selT=new Date().toISOString();cloudAll();save();render();toast('Scenario demo caricato')}
function zero(){if(!canEdit())return;if(!confirm('Riportare tutti i 114 punti e tutti gli shelter in servizio? Il registro resta.'))return;S.st={};S.shKo={};S.sel=null;cloudUpdate({st:null,shKo:null});pushHist({t:new Date().toISOString(),id:'TUTTI',slot:'—',m:'ok',op:S.cfg.op,note:'Azzeramento guasti'});save();render();toast('Tutti i punti disponibili')}

/* ======================= CALCOLI ======================= */
function staffing(ev,wait){if(!ev.length)return{n:0,max:0};const ex=[];for(const off of[-1440,0,1440])for(const x of ev)ex.push({...x,tt:x.t+off});ex.sort((a,b)=>a.tt-b.tt);
  for(let n=1;n<=30;n++){const free=Array(n).fill(-1e9);let ok=true,mx=0;for(const x of ex){let k=0;for(let j=1;j<n;j++)if(free[j]<free[k])k=j;const b=Math.max(free[k],x.tt),d=b-x.tt;if(d>wait){ok=false;break}if(x.tt>=0&&x.tt<1440)mx=Math.max(mx,d);free[k]=b+8}if(ok)return{n,max:mx}}return{n:30,max:null}}
function peak30(ev){const a=[...ev.map(r=>r.t-1440),...ev.map(r=>r.t),...ev.map(r=>r.t+1440)].sort((x,y)=>x-y);let best=0;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(a[i]<0||a[i]>=1440)continue;let j=i;while(j<a.length&&a[j]<a[i]+30)j++;best=Math.max(best,j-i)}return best}
function calc(){
  const ko=P.filter(p=>mode(p)==='ko'),deg=P.filter(p=>mode(p)==='deg'),sin=P.filter(p=>mode(p)==='sin'),un=[...ko,...sin];
  const lostKw=P.reduce((a,p)=>a+lost(p),0),pct=100*un.length/N;
  const ev=quota(R,un.length/N);
  const cm=staffing(ev,+S.cfg.wait),pk=peak30(ev);
  const gp=GK.map(g=>{const ps=P.filter(p=>p.g===g);return{g,...G[g],ko:ps.filter(p=>mode(p)==='ko').length,sin:ps.filter(p=>mode(p)==='sin').length,deg:ps.filter(p=>mode(p)==='deg').length,un:ps.filter(unav).length,lost:ps.reduce((a,p)=>a+lost(p),0)}});
    /* livelli secondo la matrice "Valutazione scenari di guasto" San Donato */
  const c=S.cfg,capUn=100*un.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.kw,0)/KW,f1=v=>fmt(v,1)+' %';
  const fulls=gp.filter(x=>x.un===x.pts),main=fulls.filter(x=>['S1','S2','S4','S10'].includes(x.g)),has=g=>fulls.some(x=>x.g===g);
  let best={r:0,l:'Nessun impatto',why:'tutti i '+N+' punti disponibili.'};const up=(rk,l,why)=>{if(rk>best.r)best={r:rk,l,why}};
  const tail=' · '+f1(pct)+' punti / '+f1(capUn)+' potenza persa.';
  if(un.length===N)up(7,'Emergenza massima','black-out totale: nessuna ricarica residua, aumentare il CMF non ripristina la capacità.');
  if(main.length>=3)up(7,'Emergenza massima',main.map(x=>x.n).join(' + ')+' fuori servizio'+tail);
  if(main.length===2)up(6,'Emergenza grave',main.map(x=>x.n).join(' + ')+' fuori servizio'+tail);
  if(has('S4'))up(6,'Emergenza grave','Shelter 4 SIEMENS fuori servizio'+tail);
  for(const g of['S1','S2','S10'])if(has(g))up(5,'Emergenza operativa',G[g].n+' '+G[g].brand+' fuori servizio'+tail);
  if(has('S3'))up(4,'Criticità localizzata','Shelter 3 COET fuori servizio'+tail);
  if(pct>=c.em||capUn>=c.em)up(7,'Emergenza massima','oltre la soglia del '+fmt(c.em)+' %'+tail);
  if(pct>=c.eg||capUn>=c.egc)up(6,'Emergenza grave','oltre '+fmt(c.eg)+' % punti o '+fmt(c.egc)+' % potenza'+tail);
  if(pct>=c.eo||capUn>=c.eo)up(5,'Emergenza operativa','oltre '+fmt(c.eo)+' % di punti o potenza'+tail);
  if(pct>=c.aa)up(4,'Allerta alta','oltre '+fmt(c.aa)+' % dei punti'+tail);
  if(cm.n>=2)up(3,'Allerta operativa','stima rientri da spostare: nel picco servono '+cm.n+' CMF per le prime manovre'+tail);
  const ocUn=gp.find(x=>x.g==='OC').un;if(ocUn)up(2,'Allerta funzionale',ocUn+' pantografo/i O.C. non disponibili: impatto da valutare per linea'+tail);
  if(pct>=c.al)up(2,'Allerta','oltre '+fmt(c.al)+' % dei punti'+tail);
  if(un.length||deg.length)up(1,'Gestibile',un.length+' punti non disponibili'+(deg.length?', '+deg.length+' in degrado':'')+tail);
  const lv=best.r===0?0:best.r===1?1:best.r<=4?2:3;
  const fullShelter=fulls[0];
  const fascia=(a,b)=>staffing(ev.filter(r=>r.t>=a&&r.t<b),+c.wait).n;
  const cm19=fascia(1140,1380),cm00=fascia(0,180),mezzi=ev.length;
  return{ko,deg,sin,un,lostKw,res:KW-lostKw,pct,capUn,degPct:100*deg.length/N,ev,cm,pk,gp,lv,rank:best.r,sub:best.l,why:best.why,fullShelter,cm19,cm00,mezzi};
}

/* ======================= MAPPA ======================= */
const ARROW_L='<svg viewBox="0 0 34 20"><path d="M32 10H6M12 3 4 10l8 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
const ARROW_D='<svg viewBox="0 0 20 36"><path d="M10 2v28M3 23l7 8 7-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
const ARROW_U='<svg viewBox="0 0 20 36"><path d="M10 34V6M3 13l7-8 7 8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
/* frecce di marcia fra le file: [posizione %, direzione] */
const LANES=[[[30,'l'],[76,'l']],[[55,'l'],[93,'l']],[[1,'d'],[35,'l'],[88,'l']],[[18,'l'],[72,'l']],[[1,'d'],[33,'l'],[80,'l']],[[20,'l'],[75,'l']],[[6,'d'],[38,'l'],[92,'l']]];
const ROWS=['F','E','D','C','B','A'];
function groupsFor(row){
  const ps=P.filter(p=>p.slot[0]===row).sort((a,b)=>+b.slot.slice(1)-+a.slot.slice(1));
  const runs=[];for(const p of ps){const last=runs[runs.length-1];if(last&&last.g===p.g)last.ps.push(p);else runs.push({g:p.g,ps:[p]})}
  const out=[];
  for(const r of runs){
    if(r.g==='S4'||r.g==='S2'){const m=new Map();for(const p of r.ps){const k=p.id.match(/^\d+\.\d+/)[0];if(!m.has(k))m.set(k,[]);m.get(k).push(p)}m.forEach(v=>out.push(v))}
    else if(r.g==='OC'||r.ps.length<=3)out.push(r.ps);
    else{const a=r.ps.slice();if(a.length%2)out.push(a.splice(0,3));while(a.length)out.push(a.splice(0,2))}
  }
  return out;
}
function tileHTML(p){return `<button class="t s-${p.g}" data-id="${esc(p.id)}" title="${esc(p.id)} · stallo ${p.slot} · ${p.kw} kW · ${G[p.g].n}"><span class="flag"></span><span class="kw">${p.kw}kW</span><b>${esc(p.id)}</b><span class="sl">${slotTxt(p.slot)}</span></button>`}
function shBox(g,extra=''){return `<button class="shbox sh-${g}" data-sh="${g}" title="Clic: KO / ripristino intero ${G[g].n}" ${extra}>${g==='OC'?'CABINA<br>':G[g].lab+'<br>'}${fmt(G[g].kw)} kW<br>${G[g].brand}</button>`}
function drawYard(){
  let h='<div class="rows">';
  ROWS.forEach((row,i)=>{
    h+=laneHTML(LANES[i]);
    h+=`<div class="yrow" data-row="${row}">`;
    for(const grp of groupsFor(row)){
      h+=`<div class="grp">${grp.map(tileHTML).join('')}</div>`;
      if(row==='B'&&grp[0].id.startsWith('2.3'))h+=`<div class="grp">${shBox('S2','style="width:96px;height:46px"')}</div>`;
    }
    h+=`<span class="lt">${row}</span></div>`;
  });
  h+=laneHTML(LANES[6])+'</div>';
  // colonna destra: fila M + shelter 4/3
  const M=P.filter(p=>p.slot[0]==='M').sort((a,b)=>+b.slot.slice(1)-+a.slot.slice(1));
  h+='<div class="rcol">'+M.map((p,i)=>tileHTML(p).replace('class="t ','style="top:'+(i*64)+'px" class="t ')).join('')
    +`<span class="mlt" style="top:248px">M</span>`
    +shBox('S4','style="top:236px"')+shBox('S3','style="top:320px"')
    +`<span class="ar" style="top:408px">${ARROW_U}</span><span class="ar" style="top:500px">${ARROW_U}</span></div>`;
  h+=`<div class="yfoot"><div class="stack">${shBox('OC')}${shBox('S1')}${shBox('S10')}</div><div class="notes">In <b style="color:var(--red)">rosso</b> punto di ricarica guasto (indisponibile)<br>In <b style="color:#b88a00">giallo</b> punto di ricarica degradato (potenza ridotta)<br>In <b style="color:var(--purple)">viola</b> punto coinvolto in sinistro (indisponibile)</div></div>`;
  $('yard').innerHTML=h;
  /* accensione in sequenza: da destra (shelter) verso sinistra, fila per fila */
  $('yard').querySelectorAll('.t[data-id]').forEach(t=>{const row=t.closest('.yrow'),ri=row?ROWS.indexOf(row.dataset.row):0,x=t.getBoundingClientRect?0:0;t.style.setProperty('--d',(ri*70+[...(row||t.parentNode).querySelectorAll('.t')].reverse().indexOf(t)*16)+'ms')});
  $('yard').classList.add('boot');setTimeout(()=>$('yard').classList.remove('boot'),2200);
  $('yard').querySelectorAll('.t[data-id]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openModal(b.dataset.id)));
  $('yard').querySelectorAll('[data-sh]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openShelter(b.dataset.sh)));
}
function laneHTML(arr){return '<div class="lane">'+arr.map(([x,d])=>`<span class="ar ${d==='d'?'dn':''}" style="left:${d==='d'?'-35px':x+'%'}">${d==='d'?ARROW_D:ARROW_L}</span>`).join('')+'</div>'}
function fitYard(){const w=$('yscroll').clientWidth;const z=Math.max(.55,Math.min(1.6,(w-4)/1180));$('yard').style.zoom=z}
let WAVE_FROM=null;
function refreshTiles(s){
  const q=F.q;
  const booting=$('yard').classList.contains('boot'),changed=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('#yard .t[data-id]').forEach(b=>{
    const p=BY[b.dataset.id],m=mode(p),prev=b.dataset.m;
    if(prev!==undefined&&prev!==m&&!booting)changed.push([b,m!=='ok']);
    b.dataset.m=m;
    b.classList.remove('ko','deg','sin');if(m!=='ok')b.classList.add(m);
    b.classList.toggle('shko',viaSh(p));b.querySelector('.flag').textContent=viaSh(p)?'SH':m==='ko'?'KO':m==='sin'?'SIN':'';b.title=p.id+' · stallo '+p.slot+' · '+p.kw+' kW · '+G[p.g].n+(viaSh(p)?' · KO PER SHELTER':'');
    b.classList.toggle('sel',S.sel===p.id);
    const vis=(F.g==='all'||p.g===F.g)&&F.st.has(m);
    const hit=q&&(p.id.toLowerCase().includes(q)||p.slot.toLowerCase().includes(q)||slotTxt(p.slot).toLowerCase()===q);
    b.classList.toggle('dim',!vis||(q&&!hit));b.classList.toggle('hit',!!hit);
  });
  /* onda: parte dal riquadro dello shelter appena comandato, altrimenti in ordine */
  if(changed.length){const o=WAVE_FROM&&document.querySelector(`#yard .shbox[data-sh="${WAVE_FROM}"]`),oc=o?o.getBoundingClientRect():null;
    changed.forEach(([b,off],i)=>{let d=i*22;if(oc){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();d=Math.hypot(r.left-oc.left,r.top-oc.top)*0.9}
      b.classList.remove('chg-off','chg-on');void b.offsetWidth;b.style.setProperty('--w',Math.round(d)+'ms');b.classList.add(off?'chg-off':'chg-on');setTimeout(()=>b.classList.remove('chg-off','chg-on'),d+700)});}
  WAVE_FROM=null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.shbox[data-sh]').forEach(b=>{const g=b.dataset.sh,ko=!!S.shKo[g];b.classList.toggle('ko',ko);let k=b.querySelector('.kob');if(ko&&!k){k=document.createElement('span');k.className='kob';k.textContent='SHELTER KO';b.append(k)}if(!ko&&k)k.remove()});
}

/* ======================= RENDER ======================= */
function groupRows(list,withKw=true){const m=new Map();for(const p of list){const k=G[p.g].brand+'|'+p.kw+'|'+G[p.g].lab;m.set(k,(m.get(k)||0)+1)}
  return [...m.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k,n])=>{const[b,kw,gr]=k.split('|');return `<tr><td>${n}</td><td>${b}</td>${withKw?`<td>${kw}</td>`:''}<td>${gr}</td></tr>`})}
function sbox(ic,title,list,pct,withKw){const m=new Map();for(const p of list){const k=G[p.g].brand+(withKw?' '+p.kw+' kW':'')+' · '+(p.g==='OC'?'O.C.':p.g);m.set(k,(m.get(k)||0)+1)}
  const ch=[...m.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),tip=ch.map(([k,n])=>n+'× '+k).join('\n');
  return `<div class="hd" title="${esc(tip)}">${ic} ${title}<span class="n">${list.length}</span>${pct!=null?`<span class="p">${fmt(pct,1)} %</span>`:''}</div>`+(list.length?`<div class="chips" title="${esc(tip)}">${ch.slice(0,3).map(([k,n])=>`<span><b>${n}</b>${esc(k)}</span>`).join('')}${ch.length>3?`<span>+${ch.length-3}</span>`:''}</div>`:'<div class="empty">Nessun punto</div>')}
const IC_KO='<i class="i3d ko" style="width:30px;height:30px"></i>';
const IC_DEG='<i class="i3d degrado" style="width:30px;height:30px"></i>';
const IC_SIN='<i class="i3d sinistro" style="width:34px;height:34px"></i>';
const LV_TXT=['Nessun impatto','Preallerta','Allerta','Emergenza'];
function tween(id,to,f){const el=$(id),from=el.dataset.v==null?to:+el.dataset.v;el.dataset.v=to;if(from===to||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){el.textContent=f(to);return}
  el.classList.remove('bump');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('bump');const t0=performance.now(),D=650;cancelAnimationFrame(el._raf);
  const step=t=>{const k=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/D),e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3),v=from+(to-from)*e;el.textContent=f(k<1?(Number.isInteger(to)&&Number.isInteger(from)?Math.round(v):v):to);if(k<1)el._raf=requestAnimationFrame(step)};el._raf=requestAnimationFrame(step)}
function render(){
  const s=calc(),c=S.cfg,now=S.upd||new Date().toISOString();
  $('updTxt').textContent=dt(now,true);$('mapDate').textContent=dt(now,true);
  $('mapKw').textContent=fmt(KW)+' kW';$('mapN').textContent=N;
  const on=$('online');on.className='online'+(s.lv>=3?' bad':s.lv>=2?' warn':'');on.querySelector('span').textContent=s.lv>=2?s.sub:'Impianto online';
  const anom=s.un.length+s.deg.length;$('bellN').textContent=anom;$('bellN').style.display=anom?'grid':'none';
  $('boxKo').innerHTML=sbox(IC_KO,'Indisponibili',s.un,s.pct,true);
  $('boxDeg').innerHTML=sbox(IC_DEG,'In degrado',s.deg,s.degPct,true);
  $('boxSin').innerHTML=sbox(IC_SIN,'Sinistri',s.sin,null,false);
  // KPI
  $('kTot').textContent=N;tween('kKo',s.un.length,v=>fmt(v));tween('kPct',s.pct,v=>fmt(v,1)+' %');tween('kLost',s.lostKw,v=>fmt(v)+' kW');tween('kRes',s.res,v=>fmt(v)+' kW');$('kInst').textContent=fmt(KW)+' kW';
  // shelter
  $('shGrid').innerHTML=s.gp.map(x=>{const ko=!!S.shKo[x.g],st=ko?'<span class="st k">SHELTER KO</span>':x.un||x.deg?`<span class="st p">${x.un} KO · ${x.deg} degr.</span>`:'<span class="st">IN SERVIZIO</span>';
    return `<button class="shc s-${x.g} ${ko?'k':''}" data-sh2="${x.g}"><b>${x.n}</b><small>${x.brand} · ${x.pts} punti · ${fmt(x.kw)} kW</small>${st}</button>`}).join('');
  $('shGrid').querySelectorAll('[data-sh2]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openShelter(b.dataset.sh2));
  // allerta
  document.querySelectorAll('.lv').forEach(d=>d.classList.toggle('on',+d.dataset.l===s.lv));
  const am=$('amsg');am.className='amsg n'+s.lv;
  am.innerHTML='<b>'+esc(s.sub)+':</b> '+esc(s.why);
  document.querySelectorAll('.lv').forEach(d=>{let k=d.querySelector('.lsub');if(!k){k=document.createElement('small');k.className='lsub';d.append(k)}k.textContent=+d.dataset.l===s.lv&&s.sub!==d.dataset.base?s.sub:''});
  // donut
  const r=42,C=2*Math.PI*r,frac=Math.min(1,s.pct/100);
  if(!$('donutArc'))$('donut').innerHTML=`<svg width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 120 120"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="${r}" fill="none" stroke="#e6ebf0" stroke-width="16"/><circle id="donutArc" cx="60" cy="60" r="${r}" fill="none" stroke="#e0343d" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="0 ${C}" transform="rotate(-90 60 60)"/><text id="donutTxt" x="60" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" font-weight="800" fill="#1b2a3a"></text></svg>`;
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>$('donutArc').setAttribute('stroke-dasharray',`${s.pct?Math.max(frac*C,3):0} ${C}`));$('donutTxt').textContent=fmt(s.pct,1)+' %';
  // barre per shelter
  const mx=Math.max(3,...s.gp.map(x=>x.un));
  if(!$('bars').querySelector('.bar'))$('bars').innerHTML='<div class="ax"></div>'+s.gp.map(x=>`<div class="bar" data-g="${x.g}"><span></span><i style="height:0%"></i></div>`).join('');
  $('bars').querySelector('.ax').innerHTML=[0,1,2,3].map(i=>`<span>${Math.round(mx*i/3)}</span>`).join('');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>s.gp.forEach(x=>{const b=$('bars').querySelector(`.bar[data-g="${x.g}"]`);b.title=`${x.n}: ${x.un} indisponibili, ${x.deg} in degrado`;b.querySelector('span').textContent=x.un;const i=b.querySelector('i');i.className=x.un?'':'y';i.style.height=(x.un?100*x.un/mx:0)+'%'}));
  $('blab').innerHTML=s.gp.map(x=>`<span>${x.g==='OC'?'OC':x.g}</span>`).join('');
  // tipologia
  const types=[[[120,180],'120 kW+'],[[100],'100 kW'],[[80],'80 kW'],[[60],'60 kW'],[[200],'200 kW (O.C.)']];
  $('tipo').innerHTML='<tr><th>Tipologia (kW)</th><th>N. guasti</th></tr>'+types.map(([k,l])=>`<tr><td>${l}</td><td>${s.un.filter(p=>k.includes(p.kw)).length}</td></tr>`).join('')+`<tr class="tot"><td>Totale</td><td>${s.un.length}</td></tr>`;
  // CMF
  $('cmf').innerHTML=`<div class="it"><i class="i3d cmf" style="width:26px;height:26px"></i><div><small>CMF stimati </small><b>${s.cm.n}</b></div></div>
  <div class="it"><i class="i3d usc" style="width:26px;height:26px"></i><div><small>Rientri stimati su KO</small><b>${s.ev.length}</b> <span class="muted" style="font-size:11px">picco ${s.pk} in 30'</span></div></div>
  <div class="it g"><i class="i3d clock" style="width:24px;height:24px"></i><div><small>Autisti 19–23 / 00–03</small><b style="color:#167a40">${s.cm19} / ${s.cm00}</b></div></div>`;
  // ultime
  $('lastEv').innerHTML=evTable(S.hist.slice(0,S.sel?3:4),false,S.sel);
  $('fullEv').innerHTML=evTable(S.hist,true);
  refreshTiles(s);renderPages(s);renderUscite();
}
function evTable(list,full,sel){if(!list.length&&!sel)return'<tr><td class="muted" style="padding:14px">Nessuna segnalazione registrata.</td></tr>';
  const sp=sel&&BY[sel];
  return `<tr><th>Data/Ora</th><th>Colonnina</th><th>Stato</th><th>Operatore</th><th>Note</th></tr>`+(sp?`<tr><td>${dt(S.selT||new Date().toISOString())}</td><td><b>${slotTxt(sp.slot)} (${esc(sp.id)})</b></td><td><span class="pill sel">Selezionata</span></td><td>--</td><td>--</td></tr>`:'')+list.map(e=>{const p=BY[e.id];return `<tr><td>${dt(e.t,full)}</td><td><b>${p?slotTxt(e.slot)+' ('+esc(e.id)+')':esc(e.id)}</b></td><td><span class="pill ${e.m}">${ST_LAB[e.m]}</span></td><td>${esc(e.op)||'--'}</td><td>${esc(e.note)||'--'}</td></tr>`}).join('')}
function tbl(h,rows){return '<table class="tt" style="font-size:12px"><tr>'+h.map(x=>`<th style="text-align:left">${esc(x)}</th>`).join('')+'</tr>'+rows.map(r=>'<tr>'+r.map(v=>`<td style="text-align:left">${esc(v)}</td>`).join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</table>'}
function renderPages(s){
  const k=[['Punti di ricarica',N,'Base piazzale'],['Indisponibili',s.un.length,fmt(s.pct,1)+' % · di cui '+s.sin.length+' sinistri'],['In degrado',s.deg.length,'Potenza ridotta'],['kW persi',fmt(s.lostKw)+' kW',fmt(100*s.lostKw/KW,1)+' % del nominale'],['Potenza residua',fmt(s.res)+' kW','su '+fmt(KW)+' kW'],['Rientri stimati su KO',s.ev.length,s.cm.n+' CMF stimati · su '+R.length+' rientri in ricarica']];
  $('dashKpi').innerHTML=k.map(([a,b,c])=>`<div class="card"><div class="muted" style="font-weight:700">${a}</div><div class="big">${b}</div><div class="muted">${c}</div></div>`).join('');
  const shRows=s.gp.map(x=>[x.n,x.brand,x.pts,x.ko,x.sin,x.deg,fmt(x.kw)+' kW',fmt(x.lost)+' kW',fmt(x.kw-x.lost)+' kW']);
  $('dashSh').innerHTML=tbl(['Gruppo','Costruttore','Punti','Guasti','Sinistri','Degr.','Nominale','Persi','Disponibile'],shRows);
  $('dashLv').innerHTML=`<div class="big" style="color:${['#167a40','#b88a00','#d66d00','#c4232c'][s.lv]}">${esc(s.sub)}</div><p class="muted">${esc(s.why)}</p><p class="muted" style="font-size:12px">Mezzi da spostare (stima): <b>${s.mezzi}</b> · Autisti 19–23: <b>${s.cm19}</b> · 00–03: <b>${s.cm00}</b></p>`;
  const FASCE=[['00–03',0,180],['03–06',180,360],['06–09',360,540],['09–12',540,720],['12–15',720,900],['15–19',900,1140],['19–23',1140,1380],['23–24',1380,1440]];
  const fr=FASCE.map(([l,a,b])=>{const tot=R.filter(r=>r.t>=a&&r.t<b).length,st=s.ev.filter(r=>r.t>=a&&r.t<b).length;return[l,tot,st]});
  $('dashRet').innerHTML=tbl(['Fascia','Rientri in ricarica (programma)','Da spostare (stima '+fmt(s.pct,1)+' %)'],fr.map(([l,t,x])=>[l,t,x]));
  const b=Array(24).fill(0),bt=Array(24).fill(0);R.forEach(r=>bt[Math.floor(r.t/60)]++);s.ev.forEach(r=>b[Math.floor(r.t/60)]++);const m=Math.max(1,...bt);
  $('hours').innerHTML=bt.map((n,i)=>`<div class="hrow" title="${n} rientri in ricarica, ${b[i]} da spostare (stima)"><b>${String(i).padStart(2,'0')}:00</b><div class="tr" style="position:relative"><i style="width:${100*n/m}%;background:#b9d0ea"></i><i style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:${100*b[i]/m}%;background:var(--red)"></i></div><span>${b[i]}/${n}</span></div>`).join('');
  $('anCmf').innerHTML=`<div class="big">${s.cm.n} CMF</div><p style="margin:4px 0"><b>Autisti necessari 19:00–23:00:</b> ${s.cm19} · <b>00:00–03:00:</b> ${s.cm00} · <b>Mezzi da spostare (stima):</b> ${s.mezzi}</p><p class="muted">Stima: ${fmt(s.pct,1)} % dei ${R.length} rientri in ricarica del programma, distribuiti nella giornata. Operatori teorici per prime manovre di 8 min entro ${S.cfg.wait} min dal rientro.</p><p><b>Picco stimato in 30 min:</b> ${s.pk}</p><div class="note w">Non è il fabbisogno CMF complessivo del turno.</div>`;
  $('anTab').innerHTML=tbl(['Fascia','Rientri in ricarica (programma)','Da spostare (stima)','CMF stimati'],fr.map(([l,t,x],i)=>[l,t,x,staffing(s.ev.filter(r=>r.t>=FASCE[i][1]&&r.t<FASCE[i][2]),+S.cfg.wait).n]));
  $('repHead').innerHTML=`<h2 style="margin:0 0 6px">Deposito San Donato — Situazione piazzale al ${dt(S.upd||new Date().toISOString(),true)}</h2><p style="margin:0">Punti <b>${N}</b> · Indisponibili <b>${s.un.length}</b> (${fmt(s.pct,1)} %) di cui sinistri <b>${s.sin.length}</b> · In degrado <b>${s.deg.length}</b> · kW persi <b>${fmt(s.lostKw)}</b> · Residui <b>${fmt(s.res)} kW</b> · Livello <b>${esc(s.sub)}</b> · Rientri stimati su KO <b>${s.ev.length}</b> su ${R.length}</p><p class="muted" style="margin:8px 0 0">Stati inseriti manualmente, non telemetria. Potenze nominali da XLSX (10.380 kW).</p>`;
  $('repSh').innerHTML=tbl(['Shelter','Costruttore','Punti','Guasti','Sinistri','Degradati','kW nominali','kW persi','kW residui'],s.gp.map(x=>[x.n,x.brand,x.pts,x.ko,x.sin,x.deg,fmt(x.kw),fmt(x.lost),fmt(x.kw-x.lost)]));
  const bad=P.filter(p=>mode(p)!=='ok');
  $('repPts').innerHTML=bad.length?tbl(['Punto','Stallo','Shelter','kW','Stato','kW persi','Operatore','Note'],bad.map(p=>{const x=S.st[p.id];if(viaSh(p)){const k=S.shKo[p.g];return[p.id,slotTxt(p.slot),G[p.g].n,p.kw,'KO per shelter',fmt(lost(p)),k.op||'',k.note||'']}return[p.id,slotTxt(p.slot),G[p.g].n,p.kw,ST_LAB[x.m]+(x.m==='deg'?' −'+x.loss+'%':''),fmt(lost(p)),x.op||'',x.note||'']})):'<p class="muted">Tutte le postazioni disponibili.</p>';
}

/* ======================= USCITE ======================= */
let UF={tab:'all',q:''};
function uRows(){const q=UF.q;return U.filter(x=>{if(UF.tab!=='all'&&x.u!==+UF.tab)return false;
  if(q){const hay=[x.line,x.turno,x.out,x.rin,x.uq+' '+x.n].join(' ').toLowerCase();if(!hay.includes(q))return false}return true})}
function renderUscite(){
  $('progDate').textContent=PROG_DATE;
  const cnt=[0,1,2].map(i=>U.filter(x=>x.u===i).length);
  $('uTabs').innerHTML=[['all','Tutte ('+U.length+')'],['0','Prima ('+cnt[0]+')'],['1','Seconda ('+cnt[1]+')'],['2','Terza ('+cnt[2]+')']].map(([k,l])=>`<button class="tabb ${UF.tab===k?'on':''}" data-ut="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('');
  $('uTabs').querySelectorAll('[data-ut]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{UF.tab=b.dataset.ut;renderUscite()});
  const s=calc(),eve=s.ev.filter(r=>r.t>=1140||r.t<180).length;
  $('uKpi').innerHTML=[['Righe di programma',U.length,'Prima '+cnt[0]+' · Seconda '+cnt[1]+' · Terza '+cnt[2]],['Rientri in ricarica',R.length,'da programma, senza posto'],['Da spostare (stima)',s.ev.length,fmt(s.pct,1)+' % dei rientri in ricarica'],['Di cui 19:00–03:00',eve,'autisti stimati '+s.cm19+' / '+s.cm00]].map(([a,b,c])=>`<div class="card"><div class="muted" style="font-weight:700">${a}</div><div class="big">${b}</div><div class="muted">${c}</div></div>`).join('');
  const rows=uRows().sort((a,b)=>a.u-b.u||a.n-b.n);
  $('uTab').innerHTML='<tr><th>Uscita</th><th>N.</th><th>Ora uscita</th><th>Tabella</th><th>Linea</th><th>Rientro</th></tr>'+(rows.length?rows.map(x=>`<tr><td>${x.uq}</td><td>${x.n}</td><td><b>${x.out}</b></td><td>${esc(x.turno)}</td><td>${esc(x.line)}</td><td><b>${x.rin}</b>${x.r>=1440?' <span class="muted">(+1)</span>':''}</td></tr>`).join(''):'<tr><td class="muted" style="padding:14px" colspan="6">Nessuna riga con questi filtri.</td></tr>');
}

let MID=null,MM='ok';
function openModal(id){const p=BY[id];MID=id;S.sel=id;S.selT=new Date().toISOString();save(false);refreshTiles(calc());
  const x=S.st[id];MM=x?.m||'ok';const sk=S.shKo[p.g];
  $('mWarn').innerHTML=sk?`<div class="warnbox"><b>Fuori servizio per ${G[p.g].n} KO</b> (dal ${dt(sk.t)}). Qui sotto modifichi lo stato della singola colonnina: vale quando lo shelter torna in servizio. <button class="btn sm" style="margin-top:6px" id="mGoSh">Apri ${G[p.g].n}</button></div>`:'';
  if(sk)setTimeout(()=>$('mGoSh').onclick=()=>{closeModal();openShelter(p.g)});
  $('mHead').innerHTML=tileHTML(p).replace('class="t ','class="t '+(mode(p)!=='ok'?mode(p)+' ':''))+`<div><h3>Colonnina ${esc(p.id)}</h3><p>Stallo ${slotTxt(p.slot)} · ${G[p.g].n} · ${G[p.g].brand}</p></div>`;
  $('mKv').innerHTML=`<span>Potenza nominale</span><b>${p.kw} kW</b><span>Stato attuale</span><b>${ST_LAB[mode(p)]}${sk?' (shelter)':''}</b>`+(x?`<span>Ultima segnalazione</span><b>${dt(x.t)}</b>`:'');
  $('mLoss').value=x?.m==='deg'?x.loss:50;$('mLossV').textContent=$('mLoss').value+'%';
  $('mOp').value=x?.op||S.cfg.op||'';$('mNote').value=x?.note||'';
  setMM(MM);$('ov').classList.add('on');
}
function setMM(m){MM=m;$('mSt').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.m===m));$('mLossW').style.display=m==='deg'?'block':'none';$('mSave').textContent=m==='ok'?'Ripristina colonnina':'Salva segnalazione'}
function closeModal(){$('ov').classList.remove('on');MID=null;$('lastEv').innerHTML=evTable(S.hist.slice(0,S.sel?3:4),false,S.sel)}
function saveModal(){if(!MID)return;if(!canEdit())return;const op=$('mOp').value.trim(),note=$('mNote').value.trim();setPoint(MID,MM,{loss:+$('mLoss').value,op,note});if(op)S.cfg.op=op;save();const id=MID;closeModal();render();toast(id+' → '+ST_LAB[MM])}

function dl(name,txt,type){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([txt],{type}));a.download=name;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1500)}
const tag=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'');
const csv=rows=>'﻿'+rows.map(r=>r.map(v=>'"'+String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(';')).join('\r\n');
function expPts(){dl('SanDonato_Colonnine_'+tag()+'.csv',csv([['Punto','Stallo','Shelter','Costruttore','kW','Stato','Riduzione_%','kW_persi','Operatore','Note'],...P.map(p=>{const x=S.st[p.id]||{};return[p.id,p.slot,G[p.g].n,G[p.g].brand,p.kw,ST_LAB[mode(p)]+(viaSh(p)?' (shelter KO)':''),x.m==='deg'?x.loss:'',lost(p),x.op||'',x.note||'']})]),'text/csv')}

function go(p){document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('on',e.id==='pg-'+p));document.querySelectorAll('.nav').forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('on',e.dataset.p===p));window.scrollTo(0,0);if(p==='piazzale')fitYard();if(KIOSK)kioskFit()}
const ATM_LOGO='data:image/png;base64,';
function applyLogo(){const u=(S.cfg.logo||'').trim()||ATM_LOGO;for(const id of['logoTop','logoMap'])$(id).innerHTML=`<img src="${esc(u)}" alt="ATM">`}
function syncCfg(){for(const[k,id]of[['al','cAl'],['aa','cAa'],['eo','cEo'],['eg','cEg'],['egc','cEgc'],['em','cEm']])$(id).value=S.cfg[k];$('cWait').value=String(S.cfg.wait);$('cKd').value=S.cfg.kd??20;$('cKp').value=S.cfg.kp??30;$('cOp').value=S.cfg.op;$('cLogo').value=S.cfg.logo||''}
function updFiltN(){const n=(F.g!=='all'?1:0)+(F.st.size<4?1:0);$('filtN').textContent=n?'('+n+')':''}
const VKEY='depotrack_sandonato_vista';const AUTO=()=>innerWidth>=1024?'desk':'mob';let VM=(()=>{try{return localStorage.getItem(VKEY)||AUTO()}catch(e){return AUTO()}})();
/* ======================= MODALITÀ MONITOR ======================= */
let KIOSK=false,KI=0,KT0=0,KPAUSE=false,KTIMER=null;const KSEQ=[['dash','Dashboard'],['piazzale','Piazzale']];
const kDur=()=>1000*(KI===0?(S.cfg.kd??20):(S.cfg.kp??30));
function kioskFit(){const de=document.documentElement;de.style.zoom=1;document.body.style.minWidth='1672px';
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const pg=document.querySelector('.page.on'),h=pg.scrollHeight+60+20,w=1672;const z=Math.min(innerWidth/w,(innerHeight-54)/h);de.style.zoom=z;fitYard()})}
function kioskShow(i){KI=i;KT0=performance.now();go(KSEQ[i][0]);$('kname').textContent=KSEQ[i][1];$('ksteps').innerHTML=KSEQ.map((_,j)=>`<i class="${j===i?'on':''}"></i>`).join('')}
function kioskTick(){const now=new Date();$('kclock').textContent=now.toLocaleTimeString('it-IT',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});
  if(KPAUSE){KT0+=250;$('kleft').textContent='in pausa';return}const el=performance.now()-KT0,d=kDur();$('kprog').style.width=Math.min(100,100*el/d)+'%';$('kleft').textContent='cambio tra '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil((d-el)/1000))+' s';
  if(el>=d)kioskShow((KI+1)%KSEQ.length)}
function startKiosk(){KIOSK=true;document.documentElement.classList.add('kiosk','zoomed');closeModal();closeShelter();kioskShow(0);clearInterval(KTIMER);KTIMER=setInterval(kioskTick,250);kioskTick();addEventListener('resize',kioskFit)}
function stopKiosk(){KIOSK=false;clearInterval(KTIMER);document.documentElement.classList.remove('kiosk','paused');removeEventListener('resize',kioskFit);if(document.fullscreenElement)document.exitFullscreen();
  if(location.hash==='#monitor'){history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search)}applyView();go('piazzale')}
const BKEY='depotrack_sandonato_mappagrande';
function applyBig(on){document.documentElement.classList.toggle('bigmap',on);$('btnBig').textContent=on?'⤡ Dashboard a destra':'⤢ Mappa grande';try{localStorage.setItem(BKEY,on?'1':'0')}catch(e){}requestAnimationFrame(fitYard)}
function applyView(){if(typeof KIOSK!=='undefined'&&KIOSK)return kioskFit();const de=document.documentElement;de.classList.toggle('mob',VM==='mob');
  const z=VM==='desk'&&innerWidth<1672?innerWidth/1672:1;if(VM==='desk'){document.body.style.minWidth='1672px'}else{document.body.style.minWidth=''}de.style.zoom=z;de.classList.toggle('zoomed',z<1)
  fitYard()}
