const FB_CFG={apiKey:"AIzaSyB6iU__138sUB4Tw_9DKWeat4WkN2RkVng",authDomain:"depotrack-d1d28.firebaseapp.com",databaseURL:"https://depotrack-d1d28-default-rtdb.europe-west1.firebasedatabase.app",projectId:"depotrack-d1d28",appId:"1:967480447300:web:7e79395a45964cdf348711"};
const ROOT='depotrack_piazzale_sd',PZ_EMAIL='piazzale.ricarica.sd@depotrack-d1d28.app',CKEY='depotrack_sandonato_cloudcache',NKEY='depotrack_sandonato_nome';
let ONLINE=false,DB=null,AUTH=null,UNLOCK=false,MYNAME='',CLOUD_REFS=[],RT=null,INACT=null;
try{MYNAME=localStorage.getItem(NKEY)||''}catch(e){}
const fk=id=>id.replace(/\./g,'_');const FK=Object.fromEntries(P.map(p=>[fk(p.id),p.id]));
function setDb(cls,txt){const e=$('dbst');e.className='dbst '+cls;e.textContent=txt}
function wErr(e){toast('Salvataggio non riuscito: '+(e&&e.code==='PERMISSION_DENIED'?'serve lo sblocco':(e&&(e.code||e.message))||'errore'));setDb('err','Errore scrittura')}
function canEdit(){if(!ONLINE||UNLOCK)return true;openLogin();toast('Sblocca le modifiche per salvare');return false}
function cloudSet(path,val){if(!ONLINE||!DB||!UNLOCK)return;DB.ref(ROOT+'/'+path).set(val===undefined?null:val).catch(wErr)}
function cloudUpdate(o){if(!ONLINE||!DB||!UNLOCK)return;DB.ref(ROOT).update(o).catch(wErr)}
function cloudPoint(id){cloudSet('st/'+fk(id),S.st[id]||null)}
function cloudCfg(){const{op,...c}=S.cfg;cloudSet('cfg',c)}
function pushHist(e){S.hist.unshift(e);S.hist=S.hist.slice(0,500);if(ONLINE&&DB&&UNLOCK)DB.ref(ROOT+'/hist').push(e).catch(wErr)}
function cloudAll(){if(!ONLINE||!DB||!UNLOCK)return;const st={};for(const[id,x]of Object.entries(S.st))st[fk(id)]=x;
  DB.ref(ROOT).update({st,shKo:Object.keys(S.shKo).length?S.shKo:null,hist:null,upd:new Date().toISOString()}).then(()=>{const ref=DB.ref(ROOT+'/hist');[...S.hist].reverse().forEach(h=>ref.push(h))}).catch(wErr)}
function schedRender(){clearTimeout(RT);RT=setTimeout(()=>{render();if(KIOSK)kioskFit();try{localStorage.setItem(CKEY,JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}},60)}
function paintLock(){const b=$('btnUser');b.classList.toggle('un',UNLOCK);let k=b.querySelector('.lk');if(!k){k=document.createElement('span');k.className='lk';b.append(k)}k.textContent=UNLOCK?'✎':'🔒';
  b.title=UNLOCK?'Modifiche sbloccate'+(MYNAME?' ('+MYNAME+')':'')+': clic per bloccare':'Sola lettura: clic per sbloccare le modifiche';document.documentElement.classList.toggle('unlocked',UNLOCK)}
function openLogin(){if(!AUTH){toast('Firebase non raggiungibile: controlla la connessione');return}$('lgErr').textContent='';$('lgPw').value='';$('lgName').value=MYNAME;$('ovLogin').classList.add('on');setTimeout(()=>$('lgPw').focus(),60)}
async function doLogin(){const p=$('lgPw').value.trim(),er=$('lgErr');er.textContent='';
  if(p.length<4){er.textContent='La password deve avere almeno 4 caratteri.';return}
  MYNAME=$('lgName').value.trim();try{localStorage.setItem(NKEY,MYNAME)}catch(e){}if(MYNAME)S.cfg.op=MYNAME;
  const pw='pzSD-'+p,btn=$('lgGo');btn.disabled=true;er.textContent='Sblocco in corso…';
  try{try{await AUTH.signInWithEmailAndPassword(PZ_EMAIL,pw)}
      catch(e1){if(e1.code==='auth/too-many-requests'||e1.code==='auth/network-request-failed')throw e1;
        try{await AUTH.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(PZ_EMAIL,pw);toast('Password del piazzale impostata')}   // primo sblocco in assoluto
        catch(e2){throw e2.code==='auth/email-already-in-use'?{code:'wrong'}:e2}}
      $('ovLogin').classList.remove('on');if(MYNAME)for(const id of['mOp','shOp']){const e=$(id);if(e&&(!e.value.trim()||/^Operatore \d$/.test(e.value.trim())))e.value=MYNAME}}
  catch(err){const map={'wrong':'Password errata.','auth/too-many-requests':'Troppi tentativi, riprova tra qualche minuto.','auth/network-request-failed':'Niente rete, riprova.','auth/operation-not-allowed':'Su Firebase è disattivato l\'accesso con email e password.'};er.textContent=map[err.code]||('Errore Firebase: '+(err.code||err.message))}
  finally{btn.disabled=false}}
function lockCloud(msg){if(AUTH&&AUTH.currentUser)AUTH.signOut();UNLOCK=false;paintLock();if(msg)toast(msg)}
function resetInact(){clearTimeout(INACT);if(!UNLOCK||KIOSK)return;INACT=setTimeout(()=>{if(UNLOCK)lockCloud('Bloccato per inattività (20 minuti)')},20*60*1000)}
['mousedown','keydown','touchstart','click'].forEach(ev=>document.addEventListener(ev,resetInact,{passive:true}));
function attachCloud(){CLOUD_REFS.forEach(r=>{try{r.off()}catch(e){}});CLOUD_REFS=[];
  const deny=()=>{setDb('err','Lettura negata');toast('Il database non permette la lettura: sblocca per vedere i dati')};
  const rSt=DB.ref(ROOT+'/st'),rSh=DB.ref(ROOT+'/shKo'),rCfg=DB.ref(ROOT+'/cfg'),rUpd=DB.ref(ROOT+'/upd'),rH=DB.ref(ROOT+'/hist').orderByKey().limitToLast(500);
  CLOUD_REFS=[rSt,rSh,rCfg,rUpd,rH];
  rSt.on('value',s=>{const o=s.val()||{};S.st={};for(const[k,x]of Object.entries(o))if(FK[k]&&x&&['ko','deg','sin'].includes(x.m))S.st[FK[k]]=x;setDb('live','Live');schedRender()},deny);
  rSh.on('value',s=>{const o=s.val()||{};S.shKo={};for(const[g,x]of Object.entries(o))if(G[g]&&x)S.shKo[g]=x;schedRender()},()=>{});
  rCfg.on('value',s=>{const c=s.val();if(c){S.cfg={...DEF_CFG,...c,op:S.cfg.op};syncCfg();applyLogo();schedRender()}},()=>{});
  rUpd.on('value',s=>{if(s.val())S.upd=s.val();schedRender()},()=>{});
  rH.on('value',s=>{const o=s.val()||{};S.hist=Object.values(o).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>String(b.t).localeCompare(String(a.t)));schedRender()},()=>{});
}
function startCloud(){setDb('wait','Collegamento…');
  try{firebase.initializeApp(FB_CFG);DB=firebase.database();AUTH=firebase.auth();AUTH.setPersistence(firebase.auth.Auth.Persistence.SESSION).catch(()=>{})}catch(e){setDb('err','Firebase non disponibile');return}
  AUTH.onAuthStateChanged(u=>{const ok=!!(u&&u.email===PZ_EMAIL);if(u&&!ok){AUTH.signOut();return}const was=UNLOCK;UNLOCK=ok;if(ok&&MYNAME)S.cfg.op=MYNAME;paintLock();attachCloud();if(ok&&!was){resetInact();toast('Modifiche sbloccate'+(MYNAME?' · '+MYNAME:''))}render()});
  DB.ref('.info/connected').on('value',s=>{if(s.val())setDb('live','Live');else setDb('wait','Non connesso')});
  paintLock();
}
/* ======================= PDF A3 (fotografia della pagina) ======================= */
const PDF_LIBS=['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html-to-image@1.11.11/dist/html-to-image.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js'];
function loadScript(u){return new Promise((ok,ko)=>{const x=document.createElement('script');x.src=u;x.onload=ok;x.onerror=()=>ko(new Error('libreria non scaricata'));document.head.append(x)})}
const frame=()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r)));
async function exportPdf(){
  const W=$('pdfWait');W.classList.add('on');
  const de=document.documentElement,body=document.body,prev={zoom:de.style.zoom,minW:body.style.minWidth,w:body.style.width,page:document.querySelector('.page.on')?.id.slice(3),mob:de.classList.contains('mob'),sx:scrollX,sy:scrollY};
  try{
    if(!window.htmlToImage)await loadScript(PDF_LIBS[0]);
    if(!(window.jspdf&&window.jspdf.jsPDF))await loadScript(PDF_LIBS[1]);
    closeModal();closeShelter();$('pop').classList.remove('on');
    if(prev.page!=='piazzale')go('piazzale');
    /* impaginazione da schermo PC 1672 px, come nella dashboard */
    de.classList.add('snap');de.classList.remove('mob');de.style.zoom=1;body.style.minWidth='1672px';body.style.width='1672px';window.scrollTo(0,0);
    fitYard();refreshTiles(calc());await frame();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));
    const w=1672,h=Math.ceil(document.querySelector('.shell').getBoundingClientRect().bottom);
    const img=await htmlToImage.toJpeg(body,{quality:.93,pixelRatio:2.4,width:w,height:h,backgroundColor:'#eef2f7',cacheBust:false,
      filter:n=>!(n.id&&['toast','kbar','pdfWait'].includes(n.id))&&!(n.classList&&n.classList.contains('ov'))});
    const pdf=new jspdf.jsPDF({orientation:'landscape',unit:'mm',format:'a3',compress:true});
    const PW=420,PH=297,M=8,foot=7,aw=PW-2*M,ah=PH-2*M-foot,k=Math.min(aw/w,ah/h),iw=w*k,ih=h*k,x=(PW-iw)/2,y=M+(ah-ih)/2;
    pdf.addImage(img,'JPEG',x,y,iw,ih,undefined,'FAST');
    const now=new Date(),s=calc();
    pdf.setFontSize(9);pdf.setTextColor(80,95,110);
    pdf.text('Deposito San Donato · Situazione piazzale di ricarica · '+dt(now.toISOString(),true)+(MYNAME?' · generato da '+MYNAME:'')+' · Livello: '+s.sub+' · Indisponibili '+s.un.length+'/'+N+' ('+fmt(s.pct,1)+' %)',M,PH-M+1);
    pdf.text('DepoTrack',PW-M,PH-M+1,{align:'right'});
    const p2=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
    pdf.save('Piazzale_SanDonato_'+now.getFullYear()+p2(now.getMonth()+1)+p2(now.getDate())+'_'+p2(now.getHours())+p2(now.getMinutes())+'.pdf');
    toast('PDF A3 creato');
  }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('PDF non riuscito: '+(e.message||e)+(navigator.onLine?'':' (serve internet)'))}
  finally{
    de.classList.remove('snap');body.style.width=prev.w;body.style.minWidth=prev.minW;de.style.zoom=prev.zoom;if(prev.mob)de.classList.add('mob');
    if(prev.page&&prev.page!=='piazzale')go(prev.page);applyView();window.scrollTo(prev.sx,prev.sy);W.classList.remove('on');
  }
}
function init(){
  ONLINE=typeof firebase!=='undefined';
  if(ONLINE){load();document.documentElement.classList.add('cloud');if(MYNAME)S.cfg.op=MYNAME}else if(!load())demo();
  drawYard();applyView();addEventListener('resize',applyView);$('btnView').onclick=()=>{VM=VM==='desk'?'mob':'desk';try{localStorage.setItem(VKEY,VM)}catch(e){}applyView();toast(VM==='desk'?'Vista completa (come la dashboard)':'Vista telefono')};applyLogo();syncCfg();
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>go(b.dataset.p));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>go(b.dataset.go));
  $('uq').oninput=e=>{UF.q=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();renderUscite()};
  $('uCsv').onclick=()=>dl('SanDonato_Uscite_'+tag()+'.csv',csv([['Uscita','N','Ora uscita','Tabella','Linea','Rientro'],...uRows().map(x=>[x.uq,x.n,x.out,x.turno,x.line,x.rin])]),'text/csv');
  $('q').oninput=e=>{F.q=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();refreshTiles(calc());const hit=document.querySelector('.t.hit');if(hit&&F.q)hit.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'center',behavior:'smooth'})};
  $('btnFilt').onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();$('pop').classList.toggle('on')};
  $('pop').onclick=e=>e.stopPropagation();document.addEventListener('click',()=>$('pop').classList.remove('on'));
  $('fG').onchange=e=>{F.g=e.target.value;updFiltN();refreshTiles(calc())};
  document.querySelectorAll('.fS').forEach(c=>c.onchange=()=>{c.checked?F.st.add(c.value):F.st.delete(c.value);updFiltN();refreshTiles(calc())});
  $('fReset').onclick=()=>{F.g='all';F.st=new Set(['ok','ko','deg','sin']);$('fG').value='all';document.querySelectorAll('.fS').forEach(c=>c.checked=true);updFiltN();refreshTiles(calc())};
  $('fDemo').onclick=$('demo2').onclick=()=>{if(!canEdit())return;if(confirm(ONLINE?'ATTENZIONE: lo scenario demo sostituisce la situazione REALE del piazzale per tutti quelli che hanno la pagina aperta, registro compreso. Continuare?':'Caricare lo scenario demo? Sostituisce stati e registro attuali.'))demo()};
  $('fZero').onclick=$('zero2').onclick=zero;
  $('btnRefresh').onclick=()=>{const b=$('btnRefresh');b.classList.remove('spin');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('spin');save();render();toast('Situazione aggiornata')};
  $('btnBell').onclick=()=>go('segn');
  $('btnUser').onclick=()=>{if(!ONLINE){const v=prompt('Nome operatore predefinito per le segnalazioni:',S.cfg.op);if(v!=null&&v.trim()){S.cfg.op=v.trim();save(false);syncCfg();toast('Operatore: '+S.cfg.op)}return}if(UNLOCK)lockCloud('Modifiche bloccate');else openLogin()};
  $('lgCancel').onclick=()=>$('ovLogin').classList.remove('on');$('lgGo').onclick=doLogin;$('lgPw').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')doLogin()};
  $('mSt').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setMM(b.dataset.m));
  $('mLoss').oninput=e=>$('mLossV').textContent=e.target.value+'%';
  $('mCancel').onclick=closeModal;$('mSave').onclick=saveModal;
  $('ov').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='ov')closeModal()};
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){closeModal();closeShelter()}if(e.key==='Enter'&&MID&&document.activeElement.tagName==='INPUT')saveModal()});
  $('saveCfg').onclick=()=>{if(!canEdit())return;const v=k=>+$(k).value,al=v('cAl'),aa=v('cAa'),eo=v('cEo'),eg=v('cEg'),egc=v('cEgc'),em=v('cEm');if(!(al>0&&al<aa&&aa<eo&&eo<eg&&eg<em&&em<=100&&egc>0&&egc<=100))return alert('Serve: allerta < allerta alta < emergenza operativa < grave < massima ≤ 100');S.cfg={...S.cfg,al,aa,eo,eg,egc,em,wait:+$('cWait').value,kd:Math.max(5,+$('cKd').value||20),kp:Math.max(5,+$('cKp').value||30),op:$('cOp').value.trim()||'Operatore 1',logo:$('cLogo').value.trim()};save(false);cloudCfg();applyLogo();render();toast('Impostazioni salvate')};
  $('defCfg').onclick=()=>{if(!canEdit())return;S.cfg={...DEF_CFG,op:S.cfg.op,logo:S.cfg.logo};cloudCfg();syncCfg();save(false);render();toast('Soglie proposte ripristinate')};
  $('bulkBtns').innerHTML=GK.map(g=>`<button class="btn" data-b="${g}">${G[g].n}…</button>`).join('');
  $('bulkBtns').querySelectorAll('[data-b]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openShelter(b.dataset.b));
  $('shBtns').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setSHK(+b.dataset.k));$('shCancel').onclick=closeShelter;$('shSave').onclick=saveShelter;$('ovSh').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='ovSh')closeShelter()};
  $('expCsv').onclick=$('expCsv2').onclick=expPts;
  $('expHist').onclick=()=>dl('SanDonato_Segnalazioni_'+tag()+'.csv',csv([['Data/Ora','Punto','Stallo','Stato','Operatore','Note'],...S.hist.map(e=>[e.t,e.id,e.slot,ST_LAB[e.m],e.op,e.note])]),'text/csv');
  $('clrHist').onclick=()=>{if(!canEdit())return;if(confirm('Cancellare solo il registro? Gli stati restano.')){S.hist=[];cloudSet('hist',null);save();render()}};
  $('expJson').onclick=()=>dl('SanDonato_Piazzale_'+tag()+'.json',JSON.stringify({app:'DepoTrack San Donato',v:3,...S},null,2),'application/json');
  $('impJson').onchange=async e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;try{const j=JSON.parse(await f.text());if(!j.st)throw Error('file non riconosciuto');if(!canEdit())return;if(!confirm('Importare il backup? Sostituisce lo stato attuale'+(ONLINE?' per tutti.':'.')))return;if(ONLINE){S.st={};for(const[id,x]of Object.entries(j.st||{}))if(BY[id])S.st[id]=x;S.shKo=j.shKo||{};S.hist=(j.hist||[]).slice(0,300);cloudAll()}else{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(j));load()}syncCfg();applyLogo();render();toast('Backup importato')}catch(err){alert('Import fallito: '+err.message)}finally{e.target.value=''}};
  $('btnKiosk').onclick=()=>{const u=location.href.split('#')[0]+'#monitor';const w=window.open(u,'depotrack_monitor');if(!w){location.hash='monitor';startKiosk()}else toast('Monitor aperto in una nuova finestra: trascinala sullo schermo grande')};
  $('kFull').onclick=()=>{(document.fullscreenElement?document.exitFullscreen():document.documentElement.requestFullscreen()).catch(()=>toast('Premi F11 per lo schermo intero'))};
  $('kPause').onclick=()=>{KPAUSE=!KPAUSE;document.documentElement.classList.toggle('paused',KPAUSE);$('kPause').textContent=KPAUSE?'▶':'❚❚'};
  $('kNext').onclick=()=>kioskShow((KI+1)%KSEQ.length);$('kExit').onclick=stopKiosk;
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!KIOSK)return;if(e.key==='Escape'&&!document.fullscreenElement)stopKiosk();if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();$('kPause').click()}if(e.key==='ArrowRight')$('kNext').click();if(e.key==='f'||e.key==='F')$('kFull').click()});
  /* le finestre aperte sullo stesso PC si aggiornano a vicenda */
  addEventListener('storage',e=>{if(e.key===KEY){load();render();if(KIOSK)kioskFit()}});
  $('btnPdf').onclick=exportPdf;$('btnPdf2').onclick=exportPdf;
  $('btnBig').onclick=()=>applyBig(!document.documentElement.classList.contains('bigmap'));
  try{if(localStorage.getItem(BKEY)==='1')applyBig(true)}catch(e){}
  render();
  if(ONLINE)startCloud();
  if(location.hash==='#monitor')startKiosk();
}
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
